title: DevFlow Gate Acknowledgement record
description: Independent approval record for a Gate (PRD FR-10, D5/OQ-5 resolved 2026-09-27). Lives at acknowledgements/<step>-<artifact-hash-prefix>.json next to the artifact; artifact stays immutable per FR-11.

acknowledger.description: Human user id (e.g. 'mei@team') or 'check:<name>' for automated checks (regression / benchmark passes).

signature.description: Signature over (acknowledger + timestamp + verdict + artifact_ref.hash). Algorithm is implementation-defined; architecture step picks (recommend Ed25519). Unsigned records rejected (NFR-Sec-2).

hash.description: Content hash of the locked artifact.

open_items.description: Required when verdict = accepted-with-open-items; otherwise omit.

rejection_reason.description: Required when verdict = rejected; surfaced in the error record (FR-13).
